name: Stipple (crayon-manner) engraving
summary: The plate is built up from etched and engraved dots and short flicks, so tone has no hatching. The print shows soft skin and flesh with pale dotted shading, and publishers often printed in red-brown (sanguine).

philosophy.core_thesis: A plate built from dots and short flicks, with no hatching, gives flesh and drapery a soft tone that imitates a chalk drawing.
design_principles: Build every tone from etched dots and short flicks; draw no hatching in the figure.
Make the dots small and close in the shadows, 80–120 an inch, and wide apart in the lights.
Print in sanguine red-brown for a chalk drawing look, or in warm black for a portrait.
Leave the edge of the figure soft and fade it into the paper, in an oval or a vignette.
Add a light outline only where a form needs a firm edge, such as a hat or a sleeve.
Keep a plate mark round the sheet.
anti_patterns: A hard outline round every form
Halftone dots in a regular grid

process.matrix: Copper plate with etched dots and a stipple-engraved finish
process.press: Rolling-press; some in colour, a la poupee
process.image_making: Dots etched with a needle or roulette; deepened with a multiple-point tool

inks.strategy: One sanguine red-brown or warm black intaglio ink; a colour print adds one or two inks through the same plate.

screening.rule: Make the tone with etched dots and flicks, 60–120 dots an inch, closer where the shadow is deep.

registration.rule: One plate prints the image; a colour print uses a single plate inked in several colours, with no register.

substrate.finish: Soft laid paper, pressed into the plate.

surface.impression: A plate mark of 3–6 mm; the dots stand in very light relief.
surface.sheen: Matt, with a soft glow in the sanguine ink.
surface.texture: Fine dotted shading with no line, and soft edges that fade into the sheet.

marks: pale cheeks and drapery without outline

evidence.title: Jupiter (Zeus), sanguine stipple engraving after G. Hussey

emotion.target_response: Gentle, polished charm: the viewer sees smooth skin and soft drapery, like a chalk portrait.

use_cases: portrait and decorative prints with a period look
avoid_when: The image needs a bold graphic line.

modifiers.how: Replace the dots with parallel lines that swell, and add a firm contour.
Rock the plate to get a deep, smooth dark, and scrape the lights.
